This '''skirmish''' took place outside the [[Krabbis Inn]] near the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] were attempting to help move a group of [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] safely to [[Shedu Maad]] in order to avoid capture by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces. They were attacked by a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] hired by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], but managed to defeat them with the help of [[Bazel Warv]], one of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] suffering from the psychosis. With help from [[Raynar Thul]], the Jedi were then able to convince Warv to get into the [[FloatVan]] that would transport him and the other Jedi to safety.
